column1: # Endpoint spore fraction (S1000), the 96-clone GSF1925 run.
# The full 96-clone variant matrix was not retained. These four mutations are
# the only surviving record of it, transcribed from the summary table in
#   -> sheet "Sheet3", the rows with Treatment == "LTS-S" (frequency 1/96 each).
# Provenance of the run itself: GSF1925-demultiplexing-summary.xlsx lists 96
# libraries GSF1925-BS_Heatkilled_1..96. Heat-killed selects the spore
# fraction, so this run is the endpoint spore sample. The endpoint spore data
# arrived under the run identifier rather than a *Bacillus_filtered.xlsx name,
# which is why it was previously mistaken for one of the three matrices.
# DO NOT take positions from S1000_endpoint_spore.circos.txt. That file is a
# Circos highlight track: each row is a +/-10 kb window, so its start column is
# the true position minus 10,000. Verified against the two files where true
# positions survive -- all 34 LT_NoTreat rows and both ST_Heat rows match the
# matrices exactly at +10,000 and not at all at +0.
# `gene_legacy` is the name in Sheet3. ylmG is spelled "ymlG" there (and in the
# growth-curve treatments.csv); yveA is the old name for aspP (BSU_34470).
# The displayed name is resolved from the annotation by position, as elsewhere.
